name: morning
title: Morning account review
subtitle: Exported evidence. No campaign changes made.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by kind,ref

sections.title: Data freshness
sections.sql: select ref,name,period_end,age_days from latest_performance order by ref

name: budgets
title: Budget review
subtitle: Straight-line projections from the exact cycle export. Currency is never combined.

sections.title: Cycle status
sections.sql: select ref,name,currency,measured_through,budget_cents,cost_cents,projected_cents,remaining_cents,review from budget_pacing order by ref

name: approvals
title: Approval meeting
subtitle: Local decisions only. Changes are applied separately in the advertising platform.

sections.title: Proposed changes
sections.sql: select ref,title,owner,due_date,proposed_change,rationale from actions where status='proposed' order by due_date

sections.title: Overdue follow-through
sections.sql: select * from overdue_actions order by due_date
